limitations.limitation: Interposition was attempted only on this host and these two interpreters.
limitations.effect: The negative result is host-specific. A different macOS build, a non-SIP configuration, or a signed interpreter with library-validation disabled might permit it. This lane did not and cannot test those, and does not claim interposition is impossible in general.

limitations.limitation: The Part A negative result does not prove the compiled reader performs no OS opens.
limitations.effect: It proves this lane could not OBSERVE them. The reader certainly opens the file; that is why the read succeeds. Zero observed is a statement about observability, not about behaviour. Stated explicitly in 02_OS_OPEN_OBSERVATIONS.json.

limitations.limitation: All byte volumes are synthetic-carrier observations.
limitations.effect: 763 and 2629 bytes describe 587- and 2117-byte files. They are NOT predictions about any real survey file and no real-file byte ceiling is proposed.

limitations.limitation: The header-prefix maximum used to demonstrate refusal is a C3-DEMO ceiling, not an adopted policy maximum.
limitations.effect: It shows the gate refuses before execution. Adopting a real ceiling is HQ policy.

limitations.limitation: iter_batches (RDR-02) was identified but not exercised.
limitations.effect: Its chunked whole-file read is a third reader site whose budget implications are unmeasured. A complete R9 candidate would need it measured.

limitations.limitation: The compatibility full-read path was not re-exercised in this lane.
limitations.effect: HQ191 already measured it with a disclosed in-memory allowlist injection. HQ192 did not repeat it; it relied on that result rather than re-deriving it, and says so.

limitations.limitation: No independent review of this lane exists.
limitations.effect: Hostile independent review is mandatory before HQ relies on any part of this, including the Part C positive finding.

claims_deliberately_not_made: That any OS-level file-open count was measured, bounded or enforced.
That zero observed OS opens means zero actual OS opens.
That a selected-read count was bound, or that a bounded selected read exists.
That a byte ceiling can be expressed for the compiled reader.
That synthetic byte volumes predict real-source byte volumes.
That interposition is impossible in general - only that it is unavailable here.
That the header-prefix DEMONSTRATION ceiling is an adopted policy.
That the iter_batches site was measured.
That any historical expected value, the HQ190-C or HQ191 diagnostics, or any warrant artifact was modified.

verification_discipline.non_equality_law: No finding rests on null==null or absent-field equality.
